warnings: Arms are reported side by side and are never pooled into one evaluation. This report does not rank arms and does not claim accuracy.
Live arm answers in this run (native) came from authenticated calls on the account owner's key. 12 case(s) is a smoke test, not a benchmark, and one run does not establish calibration.
A distribution a provider did not return is reported as unavailable, never as zero.
Synthetic replay probabilities are authored teaching fixtures. They measure no model capability and are not a benchmark.
S04 is a planted teaching error: the authored owner is confidently wrong. It is labelled here so it is not counted as a measured model failure.
The keyword-rules arm is hand-fit to these twelve authored cases. It shows what a delay-word rule does; its agreement count is not a baseline accuracy.
